findings.description: After adding or editing an expense, the redirect to /expenses?flash=saved|updated shows the success message but a stale list and total: the new row is missing and the edited amount/total are unchanged. The data is only shown correctly on a later load.
repro: Edit expense 1, change amount 42.50 to 50.00, save
Observe list still shows $42.50 and total $399.99 with 'Expense updated'
Reload /expenses after a few seconds: $50.00 shown; same for Add expense (no new row, total unchanged right after save)

notes: Filter, viewer permissions (403 on edit/post) and total sum checked OK.

cost.notes: estimate from 70205 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0140-$0.1685
